final_message:
I added a test that replays the recording and fails for the reason the scenario names. The expiring list comes back with only yogurt, and milk, which runs out on 2026-10-21, is missing.

The test is `tests/test_expiring_today.py`. It posts milk (2026-10-21) and yogurt (2026-10-23). It then asks `/items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21` and expects `[milk, yogurt]`. That expected answer comes from the `expected` field in `.xv/recordings/expiring-today.json`, not from the code. It expects milk first, so the fix must keep that order.
